# OpenWiki brief — TingTing

This brief steers OpenWiki when documenting TingTing. It is owned by the team;
OpenWiki reads it but never rewrites it during normal runs.

## What TingTing is

TingTing (Ting Ting) is a Vietnamese trucking logistics platform for managing
trips, drivers, customers, fleet vehicles, and financials (ledger, P&L, debt
tracking, profit distribution). The codebase is a TypeScript monorepo with three
packages:

- `backend/` — Express v5 + TypeScript API on port 3090; Drizzle ORM with
  PostgreSQL; JWT auth + Casbin RBAC.
- `frontend/` — React 18 + Vite + TypeScript on port 5173; TanStack Query,
  React Router, Recharts. Vietnamese-first copy, mobile-optimized driver
  pages.
- `shared/` — Shared TypeScript types, Zod schemas, financial calculations
  (`round2dp`, `computeTripTotals`), constants.

The currency is Vietnamese đồng (VND), displayed with no decimal places.

## Roles

| Role | Vietnamese | Scope |
|------|-----------|-------|
| ADMIN | Quản trị | Full access |
| MANAGER | Giám đốc | Trips, financials, fleet, reports |
| ACCOUNTANT | Kế toán | Financials, debt, P&L |
| DRIVER | Lái xe | Own trips, earnings, mobile pages |

## Where to look first

- `AGENTS.md` (root) and `TECH.md` — system map, stack, monorepo overview.
- `docs/codebase-summary.md` — repository map.
- `docs/system-architecture.md` — architecture.
- `docs/code-standards.md` and `standards/coding-style.md` — code conventions.
- `docs/testing.md` — testing approach.
- `standards/agent-completion-checklist.md` — completion record template.
- `docs/flows/DELIVERY_TRIP_LIFECYCLE.md` — trip lifecycle QA + user manual.
- `docs/company-files/` — original Vietnamese business documents (fuel norms,
  allowances, vehicle data).

## Key boundaries to preserve

- API transport lives in `backend/src/routes/`; business logic lives in
  `backend/src/services/`. Do not collapse them in the docs.
- The trip lifecycle (`PENDING → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED → SETTLED`) is the
  central domain flow. It deserves a dedicated workflow page.
- Financial precision is mandatory: docs must reference `round2dp()` and
  `computeTripTotals()` from `shared/src/calculations/` for any monetary math.
- RBAC enforcement is layered (Casbin policies + middleware). Both layers
  deserve a page.
- Demo mode is permanently disabled — the frontend uses the real API only.

## Conventions

- TypeScript strict mode — no `any` types.
- REST API with `/api/v1` prefix.
- Drizzle ORM for all database queries — no raw SQL.
- Vietnamese-first UI copy.
- Avoid undocumented public-contract changes.

## Task tracking

`TASKS.md` in the project root describes two tracks:

- Track 1 — E2E Trip Lifecycle Epic (Phases 1–4).
- Track 2 — Feature backlog (fuel norms, receivables, dashboard, profit
  distribution, tech debt).

When documenting work-in-progress features, link to the corresponding `TASKS.md`
item and the relevant phase in `plans/`.

## What to emphasize in pages

- System responsibility and ownership, not just symbol inventories.
- Runtime/build entrypoints (`backend/src/index.ts`, `frontend/src/App.tsx`).
- Mechanisms and control/data flow across the backend/frontend/shared split.
- Upstream/downstream relationships (DB, map providers, file uploads, RBAC).
- State, persistence, ordering, and lifecycle for the trip and ledger.
- Invariants and failure behavior (auth, RBAC denial, financial rounding).
- Configuration, security, and operational consequences.
- Extension seams for the planned Track 2 features.

## What to omit

- Pages that only mirror a directory or list symbols without explaining a
  system.
- Pages that repeat `docs/codebase-summary.md` verbatim — cross-link instead.
- Speculative behavior not present in the current source.
- Lockfiles, generated bundles, and any path matched by `.openwikiignore`.

## Language

Generate factual pages in English. Keep Vietnamese domain terms (Quản trị,
Giám đốc, Kế toán, Lái xe, đồng, etc.) in italics on first use and use them
consistently across pages.

pages.title: Admin-managed integration credentials (encryption at rest)
pages.purpose: Where Zalo/MiniMax/OpenRouter credentials are stored, how they are encrypted at rest, and how they are resolved at runtime for graph/clients.py.
instructions: Document the encryption-at-rest story for the integration_secrets model.
Reference graph/clients.py resolution path from admin-managed creds.

pages.purpose: JWT login/refresh/rotation, require_admin/require_recruiter dependencies, capability registry contracts, and parity between backend gates and frontend CanAccess.
instructions: Document capability registry contracts and how parity artifacts are checked.
Document the admin/recruiter role split and that admin implicitly passes every recruiter gate.
Reference the rate-limit fixtures on auth/login and password-reset endpoints.

pages.title: Blue/green deployment topology and release gate
pages.purpose: Production stack, image tags, edge routes, blue/green cutover semantics, and the local release-check gate that must pass before any image is pushed.
instructions: Link release-check preconditions to the lint/typecheck/unit/e2e/RAG golden path.
Note that `latest` is a convenience tag and is never used by `make deploy`.
State zero-downtime invariants: inactive color is stopped, ACTIVE_COLOR file, Caddy points only at active color, smoke gate aborts without flipping.

pages.title: System overview and component topology
pages.purpose: High-level shape of TingHire: web tier, workers, Postgres+pgvector, Redis, edge, channel adapters, and how they interact per message.
instructions: Diagram ingress → web → RQ → workers → DB/Redis → Socket.IO bridge → console.
Distinguish synchronous answer path (web → RQ → worker-chatbot → send) from background paths (persistence_low, ingest, followup, reconcile).
Reference the lifespan tick registrations in app/main.py as the operational source of truth.

pages.title: Decision trace, audit, and bot_runs resource
pages.purpose: How every bot execution is recorded: decision trace builder, audit/bot_run persistence, retention tick, and the bot_runs API surface used by recruiters.
instructions: DecisionTraceBuilder accumulates per-node entries and is finalized on send or suppression.
Retention tick interval is a Settings value; reference the actual env name and default.
bot_runs is recruiter-visible; explain how the API filters by conversation and lead.

pages.title: Bot-turn pipeline (LangGraph runtime)
pages.purpose: Per-turn pipeline: load_conversation_state → typing → agent → safety filters → pre_send_guard → send. Ports, GraphDeps, factories, runner functions.
instructions: Document that ports are Protocols; concrete wiring is in factories.build_deps.
Explain the at-most-one-in-flight turn model and the bot_lock_ttl_seconds TTL.
Mirror the runner docstring node order: load_conversation_state → typing → agent → fast_safety_filter → llm_safety_check → combine_for_presend → pre_send_guard → send_message/log_sent.

pages.title: Safety filter chain and turn routing
pages.purpose: Fast safety filter, LLM safety check, retry/rewrite, pre_send_guard ownership check, and routing intents (vacancy lookup, salary sort, recency sort, fast-model heuristic).
instructions: Document each routing intent detector and the model-selection heuristic that drives fast lane vs full agent.
Order matters: fast filter → (only if needed) LLM safety → retry at most once → ownership check → send or log_suppressed.
Reference grounding rules and how pre_send_guard rejects stale runs.

pages.title: Facebook Messenger adapter
pages.purpose: OAUTH-backed Facebook Messenger ingress, signature verification, and dispatch contract. Positioned as the secondary channel after Zalo.
instructions: Explain how facebook_policy.py gates features per page.
State the signature scheme and the OAUTH flow that issues the page-scoped token used for outbound dispatch.

pages.title: Zalo Bot Platform and Official Account adapters
pages.purpose: Two webhook endpoints, their signature schemes, ingress normalization, dispatch path, and the rule that Zalo adapters are intentionally thin.
instructions: Document the two signature schemes (Bot Platform HMAC vs OA sha256(appId+data+timestamp+secret)).
Explain how channels/registry and channels/dispatch isolate provider details from the rest of the app.
State the <1s ack invariant and the 503-on-enqueue-failure retry contract.

pages.title: Schema, hand-written Alembic migrations, and seed data

instructions: Migrations are hand-written and models mirror them; do not autogenerate.
Note that integration_secrets is encrypted at rest and external_source_sync_state owns single-page sync bookkeeping.

instructions: Document the runtime generation reset behavior after a new build.
Reference the vite-plugin-pwa auto-update reload behavior and the chunk-reload guard.

pages.title: Knowledge ingestion pipeline and category worker

instructions: Document flow: upload → parse → canonicalize → chunk → embed → write to pgvector.
Explain the category worker's relationship to project taxonomy.
Reference INGEST_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and the data ingestion recovery migration.

instructions: Document the halfvec HNSW + exact rerank ordering.

pages.title: Single-page external source sync (Google Sheet)

Explain the cron entry (kb_sync_cron) and the manual Xử lý ngay trigger.

pages.title: Conversation lifecycle, ownership, and delivery state

pages.title: Realtime push (Socket.IO server, cross-process bridge, console)
pages.purpose: How the React console subscribes to per-conversation rooms, how the FastAPI process publishes via a cross-process emit bridge, and which events the recruiter UI reacts to.
instructions: Note the rationale: replacing the SSE firehose to keep chat push off the heavy request path.
Reference the SSE-fallback realtime path used when Socket.IO is unavailable.

pages.title: Configuration, settings, and ownership of env keys
pages.purpose: Settings split between code constants (Zalo endpoints, EMBEDDING_DIM, DIGEST_*), Settings() env-loaded fields (DB pool, intervals, CORS, secrets), and admin-managed runtime credentials.
instructions: Note the DB connection budget math (workers × pool_size + max_overflow vs max_connections).
Reference pool_recycle and pool_pre_ping rationales.
Three ownership classes: code constants, .env, admin-managed. Document the boundary for each.

pages.title: Logging, structured context, and observability
